# Dimopoulos Law Firm, P.C.

> Matrimonial and family law firm led by Gus Dimopoulos, Westchester and New York City matrimonial attorney. Based at 73 Main Street, Tuckahoe, NY 10707 (Westchester County), serving Westchester, New York City, Putnam, Dutchess, Rockland and Orange counties. Focus: complex and high-conflict divorce, child custody, and high-net-worth matters.

- Phone: 914-472-4242 (Westchester), 212-500-1778 (New York City)
- Not affiliated with any personal injury firm with a similar name.

## Attorneys

- [Gus Dimopoulos, Managing Partner](https://www.dimolaw.com/attorneys/gus-dimopoulos): High-conflict divorce, child custody, parental alienation and coercive control matters
- [Kathleen Seavy, Associate](https://www.dimolaw.com/attorneys/kathleen-seavy): Matrimonial and family law in New York
- [Hannah Gaudet, Associate](https://www.dimolaw.com/attorneys/hannah-gaudet): Matrimonial and family law in Westchester County

## Practice areas

- [Divorce](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/divorce): Complex and high-conflict divorces in Westchester, New York City and surrounding counties
- [High net worth divorce](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/high-net-worth-divorce): Forensic accounting, business valuation, hidden assets and complex marital estates
- [Equitable distribution](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/equitable-distribution): How New York divides marital property
- [Child custody](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/child-custody): Custody, parenting time, decision-making and high-conflict custody cases
- [International custody disputes](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/international-custody-disputes): Hague Convention applications, jurisdiction and foreign custody orders
- [Parental relocation](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/parental-relocation): The Tropea standard and moving with a child
- [Spousal maintenance](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/spousal-maintenance): Maintenance under DRL §236(B), the statutory formula and modification
- [Child support](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/child-support): The CSSA percentages, the income cap and above-guideline cases
- [Prenuptial, postnuptial and separation agreements](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/prenuptial-separation-postnuptial-agreements): What each covers and when each is the right tool
- [Domestic violence and protective orders](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/domestic-violence-and-protective-orders): Orders of protection in New York Family Court
- [Enforcement and modification](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/enforcement-and-modification): Enforcing or changing support, custody and maintenance orders
- [Matrimonial appeals](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/matrimonial-appeals): Appellate work in New York's Appellate Divisions and Court of Appeals
- [Crisis management](https://www.dimolaw.com/practice-areas/crisis-management): Press, social media and reputational fallout in matrimonial matters
